name: Cult Fanatic

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.description: The fanatic has advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: The fanatic casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): At will: Light, Thaumaturgy. 1/Day Each: Command, Inflict Wounds, Shield of Faith.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fanatic makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

description: Cult fanatics whip their fellow believers into a frenzy, backing up their zealotry with dark blessings and a blade in each hand.
